column1: # Backlog debt. One row per issue whose state is not yet coherent, so the gate
# can land green while every case stays countable and un-ignorable.
# `sh tests/backlog/check.sh` fails in BOTH directions, the way
# tests/assertions/budget.tsv does: an unlisted problem is new drift, and a
# listed row that no longer applies is an improvement that was not recorded.
# state-disagreement   the state label and the body's `State:` line disagree.
#                      `detail` is label/state-line at the time it was
#                      recorded, so a row that changes shape is caught rather
#                      than silently reused. Most of these date from a bulk
#                      relabel to `blocked` that did not update the bodies;
#                      which side is right is a decision per issue, not
# unstamped-ready      a `ready` issue with no 40-hex evidence stamp, so
#                      docs/ISSUE_READINESS.md rule 2 cannot be checked on it.
#                      Fix by measuring its current behavior and naming the
